about: The railway the mod lays on every world. world_scale = owner's choice (80%: EverRail's 2.95 m interior doors fit a 7 Days player). Positions in 7 Days metres; height = smoothed terrain (World.GetHeightAt) + height_offset_m, grade-limited. module_length_m = the rails inside EverRail's rail module (10.0 m measured in game; model 12.0 m long, 26.5 m wide incl. ballast) x world_scale. max_lateral_accel (m/s2) sets the curve speed limit sqrt(a x radius); above it EverRail's derail timer (rule_derail_*) runs. Earthworks: ahead of the train (its chunks kept loaded) and around the player, terrain under the track is filled with bed_block (an embankment) and terrain, plants and whole trees within gauge/2 + clear_corridor_m and clearance_m above the rails are cut away (clearance covers the 80% train, 11.3 m tall), so inside hills it is a tunnel of that height; the train brakes itself short of track not yet shaped. Buildings are left alone. Inside hills (rock above the clearance) the cut narrows to tunnel_half_width_m either side, just wider than the train (wagons 9.4 m wide at 80%), to keep 7 Days' terrain rebuilding light.

rows.route: rounded rectangle inset 15% from GetWorldExtent edges

leaves the ring heading the ring's way, runs out to a POI in each biome (and to the player's first spawn), turns on a balloon loop of radius min_curve_radius_m and runs back on a parallel track to rejoin the ring further on: no reversing needed
